description: Map free-text values onto a closed set of allowed values, or abstain — Maps each input string onto one member of a closed caller-supplied set using, in order: exact match, caller aliases, a deterministic normal form (Unicode NFKC, case and accent folding, punctuation and underscore collapse), then bounded edit distance (optimal string alignment, so a swapped pair of letters costs 1). Returns the canonical value, the method, the distance and the nearest candidates; it

aliases.description: Caller synonyms; each canonical must be in allowed.

allowed.description: The closed set of canonical values.

caseSensitive.description: Skip case, accent and punctuation folding (only NFKC and whitespace collapse). Default false.

maxDistance.description: Largest edit distance accepted (default 2). The effective limit is also capped at one third of the normalized input length.

name: enum-canonicalize
